title: The Lost Tribe
start: Talk to Sigmund in Lumbridge Castle.

items.t: A light source (preferably a covered source such as the oil lantern, any Seer's headband or a bullseye lantern which can be easily obtained from the lorehound if you have 50 quest points)

recommended.t: Active Falador, Lumbridge, and Varrock lodestones, or teleport runes

rewards.t: The ability to use the Goblin Bow and Goblin Salute emotes
Quicker access to Lumbridge Swamp Caves

steps.t: Talk to Sigmund on the floor 2 of Lumbridge castle. [Chat: 1 Do you have any quests for me? › Accept]
Talk to the following NPCs about Lumbridge cellar around the castle until one of them mentions a goblin:

sub.t: Duke Horacio, in the same room. [Chat: 3 What happened in the cellar?].
[Chat: 4 What happened in the cellar?] if Dragon Slayer has been started/completed.
Cook, just downstairs. [Chat: 4 Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?]
[Chat: 2 Ask about what happened in the castle cellar] if Recipe for Disaster has been started but not finished; or
[Chat: 5 Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?] if Cook's Assistant has not started.
Hans, in the courtyard. [Chat: 4 Do you know what happened in the cellar?]
[Chat: 2 Talk about something else. › 4 Do you know what happened in the cellar?] during 2026, for the 25th Anniversary celebrations.

Father Aereck, in the church. If you have not previously spoken to him about gravestones, you must complete that dialogue, then speak to him again. [Chat: 1 Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?]
Bob the smith, in his axe shop. [Chat: 4 Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?]

steps.t: Talk to Duke Horacio. [Chat: 3 "X" says he saw something in the cellar.]

sub.t: [Chat: 4 "X" says he saw something in the cellar.] if Dragon Slayer has been started/completed.

steps.t: Descend the trapdoor in the kitchen.
Mine the wall rubble to the east.
Squeeze through the hole and take the brooch.

sub.t: Optional: Mine the wall rubble to the south for a shortcut to the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.

steps.t: Show the brooch to the Duke. [Chat: 3 I dug through the rubble...]

sub.t: [Chat: 4 I dug through the rubble...] if Dragon Slayer has been started/completed.

steps.t: Talk to Reldo in Varrock Palace about the brooch. [Chat: 3 Ask about the brooch.]

sub.t: [Chat: 2 [Talk to Reldo.] › 3 Ask about the brooch.] if you completed Desperate Times.

steps.t: Search the northern most bookcase on the western wall for a goblin symbol book.
Read the book to the end.

sub.t: Reldo will force-greet you and mention the Goblin Village.

steps.t: Talk to Generals Bentnoze and Wartface in the Goblin Village. Make sure you have the brooch with you. [Chat: 2 Have you ever heard of the Dorgeshuun? › 3 It doesn't really matter › 2 Well either way they refused to fight › 3 Well I found a brooch underground... › 3 Well why not show me both greetings? › 1 Thanks]
Grab your light source and return to Lumbridge Castle.
Climb down the trapdoor in the kitchen.
Squeeze through the hole in the wall you mined earlier.
Run through the Goblin Mine (pictured right).
Use the Goblin Bow emote near Mistag.
Right-click follow on Mistag.
Talk to the Duke. [Chat: 3 I've made contact with the cave goblins...]

sub.t: [Chat: 4 I've made contact with the cave goblins...] if Dragon Slayer has been started/completed.

steps.t: Pickpocket Sigmund for a key.
p: This is where you find the silverware.

steps.t: Open the chest in the other room for a H.A.M. hood, shirt, and robe. Make sure to have 3 backpack spaces, otherwise the outfit might disappear with no means of receiving it again.
Enter the H.A.M. Hideout in the Lumbridge forest northwest of the Lumbridge Castle by opening and then climbing down the trapdoor.
Search the crate near the ladder for the missing silverware.
Return to the Duke. [Chat: 3 I found the missing silverware in the HAM cave!]

sub.t: [Chat: 4 I found the missing silverware in the HAM cave!] if Dragon Slayer has been started/completed.

steps.t: Go back down the trapdoor in the castle kitchen.
Squeeze through the hole in the wall and follow Kazgar, who'll be waiting just on the other side.
p: "Your grace, I present Ur-tag, headman of the Dorgeshuun." - the player, at the signing of the treaty.

steps.t: Talk to Mistag.
Quest complete!
